review_type: manual visual inspection of rendered comparison sheets, not app or device testing

first_pass_issue.finding: Unequal upright comparison swatches could resemble a bar chart.
first_pass_issue.change: Replaced with a small geometric unequal-comparison mark; rerendered independently at 512 and 768.

final_findings.six_silhouettes: Single photo post, indented comment pair, two-document arrow, two-document comparison, gift-card magnifier, gift-card return-pencil are distinct.
final_findings.palette: White/pale dominant; small blue accents; no red failure cues.
final_findings.margins: No clipping; established camera and normalization retained. Horizontal two-document compositions intentionally have shorter vertical extents.
final_findings.small_sizes: At 48px the main motifs and blue accent positions remain visible. Fine gift-bow loops and pencil tip lose detail; interpretation should be supported by accessible UI labels. 80/96/112px show state detail more clearly.
final_findings.alpha: No visible white matte/halo in white and #161C27 composites; numeric alpha and fully transparent canvas edges validated separately.

not_performed: Direct scene comparison against inaccessible latest three kits

second_pass_refinement.draft-conflict: Comparison symbol enlarged 1.4x, stroke 1.2x, raised toward document center for48px distinction.
second_pass_refinement.benefit-review-rejected: Pencil enlarged1.2x and shifted right/lower to avoid return arrowhead.

provenance: Inherited unchanged review statements from v1; see v2-visual-review.json for current verification.
